ranked_bottlenecks.description: bitsandbytes INT8 path expects FP16 inputs; model computes in BF16, causing repeated BF16→FP16 casts before every quantized linear layer.

ranked_bottlenecks.name: Quantize/dequantize operations
ranked_bottlenecks.description: Each INT8 matmul requires activation quantization (FP16→INT8) and result dequantization (INT32→FP16), adding per-layer kernel launches.

ranked_bottlenecks.name: Increased kernel launch count
ranked_bottlenecks.description: INT8 path launches multiple kernels per linear (quantize, matmul, dequantize, cast) vs single GEMM for BF16, increasing CPU-side launch overhead and GPU idle time.

optimization_candidates.name: Remove redundant BF16→FP16 casts
optimization_candidates.rationale: If model inputs to quantized linears are pre-cast to FP16 once at layer entry, redundant per-op casts can be eliminated.
optimization_candidates.estimated_impact: Moderate — removes cast kernels that fire on every forward pass of every quantized layer.

optimization_candidates.name: torch.compile on non-quantized layers
optimization_candidates.rationale: Attention, RMSNorm, rotary embeddings, and MLP activation functions are not quantized and can benefit from operator fusion via torch.compile.
optimization_candidates.estimated_impact: Moderate — reduces kernel launch count for non-linear operations.

optimization_candidates.name: CUDA Graphs for decode phase
optimization_candidates.rationale: Decode is dominated by kernel launch overhead (single-token steps); CUDA Graphs can replay the entire decode step as one graph launch.
optimization_candidates.estimated_impact: High for decode throughput — addresses launch overhead bottleneck directly.

optimization_candidates.name: Kernel fusion for quantize→matmul→dequantize
optimization_candidates.rationale: If profiling shows quantize and dequantize are significant, a fused Triton kernel could combine them with the INT8 GEMM.
optimization_candidates.estimated_impact: High but complex — depends on whether MatMul8bitLt is the dominant cost.

optimization_candidates.name: Input dtype preparation (load model with FP16 compute dtype)
optimization_candidates.rationale: If bitsandbytes INT8 path is hardcoded to FP16, loading the model with torch_dtype=float16 for non-quantized components could avoid BF16→FP16 casts.
optimization_candidates.estimated_impact: Low-moderate — addresses cast overhead at the source.
